text: 能動浮力を伴うBoussinesq渦度系 Boussinesq vorticity with active buoyancy 能動浮力を伴うBoussinesq渦度系 -\Delta\psi=\omega,\quad (u,v)=(\psi_y,-\psi_x),\quad b=b_0(y)+\theta \omega_t+u\omega_x+v\omega_y=\nu\Delta\omega+\theta_x \theta_t+u\theta_x+v\theta_y+v b_0^{\prime}=\kappa\Delta\theta,\qquad b_0=.02\tanh(\sin y/\delta) 慣性密度を一定とし、密度差は浮力だけに残します。基底浮力を外力で維持した摂動形です。全浮力bの鉛直力のcurlがθxを与え、可変密度Euler系とは異なります。 Boussinesq vorticity with active buoyancy -\Delta\psi=\omega,\quad (u,v)=(\psi_y,-\psi_x),\quad b=b_0(y)+\theta \omega_t+u\omega_x+v\omega_y=\nu\Delta\omega+\theta_x \theta_t+u\theta_x+v\theta_y+v b_0^{\prime}=\kappa\Delta\theta,\qquad b_0=.02\tanh(\sin y/\delta) Inertial density is constant; density contrast enters buoyancy only. Forcing maintains the base profile. The curl of vertical buoyancy yields theta_x; this is a perturbation Boussinesq system rather than variable-density Euler. boussinesq-buoyancy 能動浮力を伴うBoussinesq渦度系 Boussinesq vorticity with active buoyancy 方程式 モデル equation model
